propose.title: Propose an artifact (the factory's last action)
propose.description: The factory proposes what it built: the artifacts (kind, path in the task's workspace, sha256, the contract's sha256 for a model), the sha256 of the task's manifest, and what its sandbox showed. The station receives it, gives it an id and asks the twin's judgment; the factory never registers and never pushes. Refused without an artifact, a sha256 or a manifest.

properties.claims: what the factory claims: the required outputs it covers, the sandbox residual and wall time
properties.artifacts.contractSha256: sha256 of its contract, for a model

registry_register.title: A device registers itself
registry_register.description: A device that plugs in says where it is (an ISA-95 path such as /habitat/lab/eclss/scrubber-1) and what it is (a descriptor: @type, title, properties with their quantity and unit, the actions it accepts, the links it declares). A device that acts and has no qualified simulator opens a commissioning, and Mother says so. Refused for a path that is not ISA-95, a property without quantity or unit, a path already registered.

properties.descriptor: what the device is: @type, title, properties, actions, links

registry_list.title: The register of the devices
registry_list.description: Every device on the register: its ISA-95 path, its descriptor (type, title, properties with quantity and unit, actions, links), whether a qualified simulator exists for it, and the last readings it reported. Reading is free.

registry_report.title: A device reports readings
registry_report.description: A device hands Mother the current value of some of its properties (a battery its state of charge). Refused for a device not on the register and a property it does not declare.

commissioning_state.title: Where a commissioning stands
commissioning_state.description: One commissioning by its id, or all of them: the device, the status (open, awaiting-authorisation, authorised, refused, running, done, aborted), the procedures checked, the procedure relayed with who is in the volume, the authorisation, the monitoring session, the steps run and the report. Reading is free.

properties.commissioningId: the commissioning; all of them when absent

procedure_checked.title: The factory's guard tells Mother of a procedure it checked
procedure_checked.description: Every procedure the factory's guard checked, accepted or refused, with its problems: Mother says the procedure proposed on the first attempt, then the refusal, or the correction when an accepted one follows a refusal. The factory's report to the station; not a tool of the agent.

properties.device: ISA-95 path of the device under commissioning
properties.volume: ISA-95 path of the volume under test
properties.speeds: the speed of each step, percent
properties.problems: the guard's problems, with their kind
properties.minSpeedPercent: the minimum speed the procedure sets for itself, percent

commissioning_authorise.title: The commander authorises a procedure
commissioning_authorise.description: The commander's decision on the procedure Mother relayed: authorise or refuse. On authorisation Mother reads who is in the volume again (refused if it changed since the check) and opens the medical monitoring of the occupants for the duration; an authorisation that cannot open it is not recorded. The commander's; never the agent's.

procedure_run.title: The run of an authorised procedure
procedure_run.description: The run as it is executed, one call per event: begin (only when authorised, and with the monitoring open when the volume is occupied), step n (in order), record (what the step's command got and the CO2 at both ends), abort (the condition that tripped), finish (all steps recorded). On abort and finish Mother closes the monitoring and writes the report. Run control; not a tool the agent's model calls.

properties.action: begin, step, record, abort or finish
properties.condition: the abort condition that tripped: co2, refused, battery, vitals, unreadable
properties.ppm: the CO2 read when co2 tripped

station://proposals.name: Proposals
station://proposals.description: What the factory proposed, with each proposal's status

station://registry.name: Register
station://registry.description: Every device on Mother's register, with its descriptor and last readings

station://commissionings.name: Commissionings
station://commissionings.description: Every commissioning with its status, its procedure, its authorisation, its run and its report; changes are pushed

station://mother.name: Mother's lines
station://mother.description: Everything Mother said, in English and French, with the data that filled each line; each new line is pushed

phrases.hello.instructions: You are the voice of the station: the on-board AI of a lunar habitat, calm, precise, brief. Write the welcome you say aloud to the crew and the operator when the control board comes up: two or three short sentences, plain words, no list, no markdown, no greeting word (the page says hello before you). Use only the facts given; do not add numbers or names that are not in them. End by inviting them to pick a simulation.
